page.layout: One printed page: a single text column below the running head "CAPVT VI." and the page number, with the catchword and gathering signature at the foot. The left-hand strip is the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: bus Ecclesiæ Catholicæ, ex responso Augu-stini. Nam ex Urbici verbis intelligimus Romanæ Ecclesiæ ingenium. Romani Pontifices affectabant semper ceremonias suas aliis Ecclesiis, tanquam jugum, imponere. Et veteratorias artes prodit iste Urbicus. Nam traditiones, quas nulla alia ratione probare possunt, scilicet ad Apostolicas traditiones referunt. Sic Urbicus iste traditionem Romanam de jejunio, ad Petrum Apostolum referre ausus est. Itaque in hoc uno facto Romanæ Ecclesiæ ingenium & mores expressos habemus. Nec minora studio ex Augustini verbis Ecclesiæ Catholicæ ingenium moresque observare debemus, contra istas Romanorum artes. Nam Augustinus contra Romanæ Ecclesiæ consuetudinem opponit Catholicæ Ecclesiæ judicium. Hæc refutatio antiquis sufficiens videbatur, ut contra particularem aliquam Ecclesiam auctoritatem Catholicæ obicerent. Eodemque modo refutabant Patres Africani impudentiam Romanorum Pontificum, Zozimi, Bonifacii, & Cælestini. Etenim Ecclesia Romana potestatem in alias Ecclesias vindicare tentabat, vivo Augustino, & Appellationes ab aliis Ecclesiis ad Romanum Episcopum fieri voluerunt. Ad eam rem conficiendam, confictum Niceni Concilii canonem jactabant Romani Pontifices. Canon ille fictitius extat Concil. Carthag.6.cap.5. Augustinus, aliique Patres

page.notes: Printed page number reads "22I", transcribed as 221. The left-hand strip (fragments such as "qui-", "fata-", "unda-", "Hæc") belongs to the neighbouring page and was left out. Running head is "CAPVT VI." as printed. Vowel-u forms in capitals were normalised per rule 5 ("Vrbicus" to "Urbicus"); consonant i was rendered as j ("jugum", "jejunio", "judicium", "jactabant"). Hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
